description: Test application performance with k6 load/stress/soak/spike scripts and k6 scenarios, Lighthouse CI for Web Vitals, and performance budgets as CI gates. Covers load profiles, custom metrics, bottleneck identification, and Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS). Use when: "performance test," "load test," "stress test," "soak test," "spike test," "k6," "k6 scenarios," "Lighthouse," "Web Vitals," "Core Web Vitals," "performance budget." Not for: scheduled production probes — use synthetic-monitoring; pixel-diff regressions — use visual-testing; designing tests from prod telemetry — use observability-driven-testing. Related: ci-cd-integration, qa-metrics, release-readiness.
